description: Displayed in the domestic area and then on the main gate at No.2 Stores Depot Chester Hill, then on the gate at No.6 Stores Depot Dubbo. When 6SD closed in 1995 the Sabre went to Narromine Airport and is on display in the wartime Bellman hangar.
Homebuilt Corben Super Ace; no registration recorded in the source used.
Full-scale replica of the Wright Model A recorded in survey listings with the registration VH-SOF; the museum own site does not publish an inventory.
